titulo_es: Ask them to talk more slowly

texto: To manage a real conversation when the interlocutor speaks too fast or in a noisy environment, essential courtesy formulas are used: «Kunt u dat herhalen?» (can you repeat it?), «Ik versta u niet goed» (I don't hear you well) and «Langzamer, alstublieft» (slow, please). To check the time: «half vier» is 3: 30, not 4: 30.

frases.nl: De afspraak is op donderdag om half vier.
frases.es: La cita es el jueves a las tres y media.

frases.nl: Sorry, ik versta u niet goed. Kunt u dat herhalen?
frases.es: Perdón, no le entiendo bien. ¿Puede repetirlo?
frases.en: I'm sorry, I don't understand. Can you repeat it?

frases.es: El jueves a las tres y media.
Más despacio, por favor. ¿Quiere decir las 15:30?

bloques.pregunta: In Dutch, what exactly is the digital time of the «half vier» expression?

opciones.explicacion: In Dutch «half» indicates half an hour before the above-mentioned time («half an hour around four.»).
Four and a half is called «half vijf».
Two and a half is called «half drie».

bloques.pregunta: What problem does Amir manifest right now?
bloques.frase: Sorry, ik versta u niet goed. Kunt u dat herhalen?

opciones.texto: He does not listen to his interlocutor with any clarity and requests that he repeat the message.
opciones.explicacion: «Niet goed verstaan» is not hearing well and «herhalen» is repeating.

opciones.texto: He's completely forgotten the day he had a medical appointment.
opciones.explicacion: He doesn't forget the day, he just asks for the information to be repeated acoustically.

opciones.texto: Cancel the meeting for incompatibility of working hours.
opciones.explicacion: He's not canceling anything, he's looking to confirm the time.

bloques.pregunta: Complete to ask you to speak at a lower speed.

opciones.explicacion: «Langzamer» is the comparative of «langzaam» and means slower.
«Sneller» would mean faster, the opposite of what is necessary.
The «langzamer» adverse form is requested to request a lower rate.

bloques.pregunta: What clarification does Amir provide to ensure the time?

opciones.texto: It proposes the time in exact digital format of 24 hours.
opciones.explicacion: Convert «half vier» to «15.30 uur» to dispel any doubt.

opciones.texto: He asks to change the meeting for the next week.
opciones.explicacion: He doesn't ask to delay the appointment.

opciones.texto: He asked for the appointment to be held by video call.
opciones.explicacion: It does not propose a change of modality.

bloques.pregunta: Complete with the word that marks half an hour in Dutch.
bloques.frase: De afspraak is op donderdag om ___ vier.

opciones.explicacion: «Half vier» is the standard way to express 15: 30.
«Tien vier» does not form a correct time expression.
«Uur» would go at the end or after an integer («om vier uur»).

bloques.frase: De afspraak is op donderdag om half vier
bloques.explicacion: Subject with copula, day of the week with «op» preposition and time with «om».

intro: He asked for clarification, for a repeat, and for a friendly approach to the pace of the conversation.
